scope: Uniaxial connector verification, cyclic history, energy-controlled complete separation, and uniform joint-row partition test. No aircraft-facade replay.

source_envelope.criterion_equation: (normal_force/Fn)^2+(shear_force/Fs)^2=1, tensile normal force only in this transcription
source_envelope.classification: Broad visual reading of a reprinted experimental failure-envelope figure; intervals are reading brackets, not confidence bounds or Boeing allowables.
source_envelope.figure_labels: 7050 countersunk rivet, diameter 4 mm, 2024-T351 plates, thickness 1.6 mm. Text uses 5/32 in and 0.063 in; retain rounding difference.
source_envelope.scaling_classification: Own D-squared same-failure-mode area-scaling hypothesis. NIST states scaling but this exponent is not explicit in the inspected pages.
not_identified: actual Boeing rivet material and location

connector.law: Triangular force-displacement envelope with linear stiffness K=Fpeak/d0; irreversible tensile plastic slip on unloading with stiffness K; zero force after full separation at df.
connector.spring_property: OpenRadioss TYPE4 H2 (uncoupled plastic unloading), to be checked against an independent reference before acceptance
connector.history_variable: p=max(previous_p, delta-Fenvelope(delta)/K) on monotonic tensile loading; failed is irreversible
connector.dissipation_formula_J: external/internal connector work minus recoverable spring energy
connector.compression: out of scope; all accepted loading paths keep delta nonnegative
connector.assumptions: d0, df, unloading form and D-squared scale are hypotheses. These parameter sweeps are not calibrated production joint predictions.

row.classification: Uniform imposed-separation patch test of capacity and energy weights only. Fractional rivet count and no plate compliance; not a spatial convergence study of an actual riveted joint.

accepted_revision_R1.corrections: Correct TYPE4 fixed-width unused field; correct BCS translation/rotation ordering; cap time step after separation with DTIX. R0 monotonic and cyclic preflights are retained and rejected for input warnings and conflicting imposed/blocked X motion.

accepted_revision_R2.corrections: Smooth imposed displacement segment endpoints with cubic smoothstep sampled into FUNCT. Avoid instantaneous velocity jumps and staggered impulse/momentum mismatch. Dynamic cases keep R1 initial-velocity input; imposed cases use R2. Original R1 histories retained.
